test_title: PYST 11: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - English Language (Held On 21 Jun, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: english
question: How can individuals contribute to reducing their carbon footprint?

options.text: By reducing energy consumption at home
By using private transportation instead of public transport

solution:
The correct answer is By reducing energy consumption at home.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage provides specific ways that individuals can reduce their carbon footprint.
 
• It mentions that using public transport instead of driving, reducing meat consumption, and reducing energy consumption at home are effective measures.
 
• Reducing energy consumption at home is mentioned as one of the measures to reduce an individual's carbon footprint.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** Increasing meat consumption would increase the carbon footprint, not reduce it.
 
• **Option 2:** Not recycling waste products contributes to environmental harm rather than reducing the carbon footprint.
 
• **Option 4:** Using private transportation instead of public transport would increase the carbon footprint, not reduce it.
